chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Ali ibn Hanzala, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Beware of the woman who is divorced with three (divorces) in one sitting, for they are with husbands.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a woman who received a triple divorce in one sitting?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) warns against marrying a woman who has received a triple divorce (Talaq al-Munfarid) in a single sitting, as she remains bound to her first husband until the completion of her waiting period (Iddah). This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly distinction between the majority Sunni view, which considers triple divorce effective immediately, and the Shia view that treats it as three single divorces, thereby requiring a full Iddah before the marriage is fully dissolved.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Ali Bin Hanzala, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Beware of the woman divorced with three (divorces) in one sitting, for they are with husbands’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr from Ali ibn Hanzalah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Beware of the case of a woman divorced three times in one meeting; they are married women.”
